subject: xtable error going from .Rmd to pdf (via pandoc)

messages.author: 048a78da5a6b06bb
messages.subject: xtable error going from .Rmd to pdf (via pandoc)
parts:
I'm having some conversion issues with knitr, xtable and pandoc:

By way of example, I can knit the following chunk and convert to pdf (via Latex) with Pandoc.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
library(xtable)
print(xtable(head(iris), align = "c|ccccc"), type = 'latex')
```
But...

If I also try read in a .csv (any csv) in the same document e.g.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
library(xtable)
print(xtable(head(iris), align = "c|ccccc"), type = 'latex')
```

```{r}
myfile = read.csv(file = "myfile.csv", header = TRUE)
```

I get the following error from pandoc:

pandoc.exe: Error producing PDF from TeX source.
! Use of \@array doesn't match its definition.
\new@ifnextchar ...served@d = #1\def \reserved@a {
                                                  #2}\def \reserved@b {#3}\f...
l.79 \begin{tabular}{c|ccccc}

The problem seems like it's stemming from the vertical line in the align argument in print.xtable, but the odd thing is I can run both chunks fine independently as they are. Alternatively, all works fine if I remove the the vertical line in align = "c|ccccc" .

Any suggestions very much appreciated.
